display.summary: Fixes only: every staging break-in finding and the 1.16 line's known bugs. The doctor tells the truth under failure: a missing task worker, missing static files or an image below the release floor are errors, and a dead database or a paused Redis no longer floods or freezes it. With Redis down, users get a clear page within seconds and stay signed in, instead of an error or a sign-out. An image older than the active release runs its own DjangoLux, and says so. New projects get a nonce-only script policy, Redis snapshots that survive a hard stop and mount points ready for a non-root user; existing projects get warning dlux.W201. Labels a superuser edits now render as text, accent colours keep readable text in every theme, and modal forms re-run their scripts after a refused submit. DLUX_UPDATE_POLICY can limit which updates the app may request. Needs Django 5.2 and Composer 1.11.0b1 or later; updates inline from any 1.16 release with one additive migration.
highlights: Fixes only: every staging break-in finding and known bug from the 1.16 line.
The doctor is truthful under failure and never hangs on a paused Redis or a dead database.
With Redis down, users get a clear page within seconds and stay signed in.
An image below the active release's floor runs its own DjangoLux and reports it.
New projects: nonce-only script-src, Redis snapshots, non-root-ready mount points.
Superuser-edited labels render as text; accent text is readable in every theme.
DLUX_UPDATE_POLICY limits which updates the app may request.
Needs Django 5.2 and Composer 1.11.0b1 or later; updates inline from any 1.16 release.
